name: Contract Clause Extractor
description: Extract & classify key clauses from contract PDFs into a structured risk summary — with bilingual (CN/EN) support.

scripts.description: CLI script implementing all workflow steps (ingest/segment/classify/risk/summarize/compare/bilingual/report)

workflowSteps.name: Risk Annotation
workflowSteps.output: Each clause tagged high/medium/low with explanation

workflowSteps.name: Hidden Risk Detection
workflowSteps.output: Structural risk alerts for imbalanced terms

workflowSteps.name: Clause Summarization
workflowSteps.output: Structured extraction table with modification suggestions

steps: Run: contract-clause-extractor.sh classify contract.pdf — extracts and classifies all clauses
Run: contract-clause-extractor.sh risk contract.pdf — annotates with risk levels
Run: contract-clause-extractor.sh summarize contract.pdf — see structured extraction table
